about.title: Center for Quality Assurance
about.paragraph: The Center for Quality Assurance is where the College's quality assurance mechanisms and processes are vested. The office is in-charge of all international, national and local quality assurance mechanisms, while working closely with top management in setting up quality assurance procedures. Its main responsibility is to coordinate, assist, and monitor the different units to strengthen their academic and administrative management and processes so that they are better able to achieve their quality goals and educational objectives.
